purpose: Research audit register, not a simulation ontology

records.context: Nippur; no specific room/archive established here
records.language_observed: Sumerian clauses; digital English translation also consulted
records.forms: nam-ibila; ad-da ti-la; dumu; šeš; ḫa-la; é du₃-a; a₂ mu-u₈-a; kalag; nam-ibila-ni-ta ... e₁₁
records.observation: The document combines heir-making, a living father’s allocations, brother terminology and conditional annual support.
records.limits: Damaged adoption wording and obv. 9 are not silently restored. No proof of biological brotherhood, co-residence or performance of the annual obligations.
concordances: P283600 is retired, not another tablet

records.context: Nippur; 3N-T0852; room not given in consulted record
records.language_observed: Sumerian legal clauses with some Akkadian elements
records.forms: nam-dam-še₃ ... tuku; dam; dumu; ad-da; nam-dumu
records.observation: Marriage and the affiliation of named sons appear in one instrument; repudiation clauses identify spouse and parent relationships.
records.limits: DAM must be interpreted relationally, not invariably as wife. Conditional penalties are not reports that a sale or repudiation occurred.

records.context: Nippur; specific excavation locus not recorded here
records.forms: nin₉; lukur; šeš-gal; ibila; nam-ibila; še-ba; ì-ba; siki-ba; é a-šà níĝ-gur₁₁
records.observation: Four brothers/heirs undertake recurrent provision for their sister Bēltani, LUKUR of Ninurta; non-provision and alienation clauses affect heirship/property.
records.limits: The field possessive in the alienation provision is contested in scholarship. Allocation vocabulary is not by itself a wage relation. Tablet and envelope constitute one case.

records.forms: máš₂ nu-ub-tuku; šu ba-an-ti; dumu-munus
records.observation: Silver is received from a named woman, identified by descent, with an explicit no-interest clause.
records.limits: Receipt is not inherently adoption or perpetual ownership. Catalogue month 02 conflicts with the written month gan-gan-e₃; retain year only for chronological comparisons.

records.forms: kislah; ḫa-la-ba
records.observation: Measured open plots are associated with named shares.
records.limits: No surviving explicit death, adoption or comprehensive household roster; ḫa-la alone does not identify an inheritance procedure.

records.forms: iti 4-kam; bara₂ Ninurta; gu-za Inanna; ḫa-la-ba; še-ga-ne-ne-ta
records.observation: Three named men receive four-month shares associated with the Ninurta and Inanna designations.
records.limits: Actual tasks, net revenues and personal performance are not specified. Institutional interpretation is not supplied by the English word office alone.

records.genre: Exchange of house plots with silver adjustment
records.forms: é du₃-a; é é-e gin₇; ki ba-gar-ra; gín; kù-babbar
records.observation: Two measured built plots are exchanged, with a silver balancing payment.
records.limits: Land-area gín and silver-weight gín must not be merged. The record is not an exchange of two complete residential groups.

records.language_observed: Sumerian wording; catalogue language not adopted as a clause-level analysis
records.forms: a-šà; orchard/property description
records.observation: An orchard plot is the object of a legal transaction associated with named parties.
records.limits: The purchaser/consideration is damaged. Do not assign the transaction to an excavated household solely from findspot.

records.date: Samsuiluna 27, month X; day discrepancy in catalogue
records.forms: é; nam-ga-an-tuš-u₃-de₃; a₂ mu-u₂-a-še₃
records.observation: A dwelling is taken for occupancy from Ninnutum, with an annual silver payment.
records.limits: Annual a₂ is rental consideration here, not proof of wage labor. Standard date/text give day 23, while legacy catalogue notation gives 13.

records.date: Old Babylonian; conflicting regnal/month catalogue notation
records.context: Nippur; finer contextual assignment not established in this register
records.language_observed: Sumerian wording with damaged possible Akkadian material
records.forms: [nam-dumu]; ama; ad-da; ibila
records.observation: Mother, father and heir terminology appears in a damaged affiliation instrument.
records.limits: Adoption phrase is restored; exact date and several relationships remain unsettled. Not used to construct a family tree.

records.passages: tablet obv. 1–13; rev. 1–4; envelope corresponding clauses
records.forms: é du₃-a; ĝišig; sa₁₀; sa₁₀-am₃ til-la; ibila; inim nu-...-gá-gá
records.observation: A built plot with fixtures is sold with payment and a future non-claim clause covering seller and heirs.
records.limits: Future successors are not a census of existing children or residents. Tablet and envelope are one transaction; X 1 is not silently normalized to XA 1.

records.language_observed: Mixed: Akkadian syntax/verbs with Sumerian logograms and legal formulae
records.passages: tablet obv. 1–9; envelope obv. and rev. 1–4
records.forms: ki-šub-ba; é ki-ma é; il-qé-e-ma; i-na-di-in
records.observation: An exchange combines Akkadian verbal/prepositional language and Sumerian-written property and closure expressions.
records.limits: Writing conventions do not demonstrate a participant’s spoken language. A catalogue language field cannot replace analysis of the clauses.

records.genre: Commodity accounting associated with a house payment
records.language_observed: Akkadian syntax with logograms and Sumerian title spellings
records.forms: lukur Ninurta; ša i-na é ... wa-aš-bu; rabiānum; nimgir; ARAD + divine name
records.observation: Explicit residence wording, a deity-linked female title, official titles and seal devotion formulae coexist in this account.
records.limits: The preceding a-si-rum is not classified here as captive rather than personal name. ARAD in a divine seal formula does not establish chattel status.

records.context: Nippur; room/archive assignment not established here
records.forms: dumu-mu nu-me-en; ama-mu nu-me-en
records.observation: Child and mother repudiation expressions survive.
records.limits: Names, relationships and penalties are damaged; no confident prosopographic reconstruction is offered.

records.context: Nippur; precise room assignment not established here
records.forms: a-šà kankal; mu 3-kam; mu 4-kam; šu su₂-ub-bu
records.observation: An agricultural arrangement distinguishes an initial three-year period and the fourth year.
records.limits: Broken performance/consideration clauses prevent a full reconstruction. A land-use arrangement is not automatically employment or a person’s permanent status.

records.context: Nippur; finer findspot not independently fixed here
records.forms: nam-šeš-gal-la; šeš-gal; ḫa-la-ba; ibila; níĝ-gu₂-na é gál-la
records.observation: Brother/heir labels and an elder-brother designation accompany realty and household-content allocations.
records.limits: Do not infer universal primogeniture or adopt an unverified family tree; seal and body patronymic wording also require contextual review.

records.date: Samsuiluna 12, month V; day 18 in transcription / 19 in catalogue
records.context: Nippur; finer context not established here
records.forms: nu-eš₃; sa₁₀; ibila; inim nu-gá-gá
records.observation: A buyer identified by cult title acquires a house plot; seller and heirs are bound by non-claim wording.
records.limits: A title-bearing buyer is not necessarily buying on behalf of a temple. The day-level date is unresolved.

records.date: Samsuiluna; year-name of destruction of Emutbal city walls
records.context: Nippur; finer context not established here
records.forms: ki ba-gar-ra; é; lu₂; nu-eš₃; lunga Enlil
records.observation: Built-plot exchange and a balancing payment are recorded; the envelope identifies the instrument as an exchange tablet.
records.limits: The generic catalogue sale label is less precise than the transaction clauses. Titles in the witness list do not establish the capacity in which each witness acted.

records.forms: é du₃-a; sa₁₀; ibila; lunga; ARAD₂-Inanna dub-sar
records.observation: A built plot is sold; a witness is named ARAD₂-Inanna and identified as a scribe.
records.limits: A personal name containing ARAD is not an independent legal-status declaration. Local name variants and duplicate surface text require care.

records.context: Nippur; 3N-T0845; room absent from CDLI record
records.forms: [ama-ar-gi₄?]; nam-geme₂; u₄ ti-la; igi-ni-še₃ ... gub; ibila; aga-us₂; sanga
records.observation: The surviving clauses distinguish lifetime attendance/service from heirs’ future claims to female slave status; Stone indexes the act as freeing a slave girl.
records.limits: The release expression is restored and queried; the marriage/document clause is problematic. This is not proof that release removed every obligation, nor a universal manumission rule.

records.date: Hammurapi 31, month XI; legacy notation indicates intercalation
records.genre: Silver loan, despite catalogue grain label
records.forms: šu-lá; máš₂ nu-ub-tuku; šu ba-an-ti; agrig; kù ... lá
records.observation: Receipt and repayment wording concerns silver and excludes interest; the borrower bears an administrative title.
records.limits: The commodity/genre catalogue is inconsistent with the displayed clauses. Office title does not establish institutional ownership of this debt.

records.forms: [nam] ì-du₈ ká é-kur-ra; u₄ 7½-kam; sa₁₀; garza₂
records.observation: An Ekur gatekeeping entitlement of seven-and-a-half days is sold; the closure calls its object garza₂.
records.limits: The initial nam is restored. Price paid for an entitlement is not its holder’s salary or a measure of work actually performed.

records.genre: Sale of a bundle of temple-linked offices; tablet and envelope
records.forms: nam-ugula é; nam-ì-du₈; nam-bur-šu-ma; mu-a u₄ 10-kam; bala gub-ba
records.observation: The envelope preserves an annual ten-day turn associated with several office designations and a sale.
records.limits: Institutional names and opening titles are damaged in places. The technical function of nam-bur-šu-ma is not resolved here.

records.genre: Sale of Nuska-temple offices with associated field; tablet and envelope
records.forms: nam-gudu₄; nam-lunga; é Nuska; mu-a u₄ 5-kam; a-šà IGI-bi; bala gub-ba
records.observation: Five annual days of cult-office rights and an associated field occur in a sale instrument.
records.limits: Envelope supports restorations in the tablet; this is one transaction. Exact field terminology/function and personal execution of duties require specialist verification.

records.date: Old Babylonian per edition; CDLI period field blank
records.language_observed: Sumerian, but current displayed transcription is quarantined
records.passages: Edition identification/abstract and catalogue only for substantive use
records.forms: No clause-level forms admitted
records.observation: Publication identifies three model court cases; current CDLI text begins with a Nippur/Warad-Sin passage that appears inconsistent with that identification.
records.limits: Do not use the displayed clauses as a transcription of the model cases until checked against Klein–Sharlach 2007 or OBMC. This is an apparent mismatch, not a certified database correction.

records.language_observed: Sumerian, with pu-uh₂-ru-um for an assembly
records.forms: dam; dumu-munus; ARAD₂ + personal name; nu-eš₃; pu-uh₂-ru-um nibru-ka; di dab₅-ba
records.observation: A school witness uses spouse, descent, service/status and assembly language in a narrated court case.
records.limits: The marriage/status relationships belong to the narrated case; this witness is not counted as an independent contemporary legal event. School transmission need not mean every element was invented.

records.publication: EEN p. 61, CBS 6098; Veldhuis 2000 pp. 385–387 cited by Spada
records.date: Old Babylonian per current catalogue; older Middle Babylonian attribution noted
records.genre: School tablet with model contract on obverse and lexical text on reverse
records.passages: Catalogue description; current displayed reverse only
records.forms: No model-contract clauses admitted
records.observation: The catalogue reports a repeated exercise contract, multiplication table and lexical material on one tablet.
records.limits: The current displayed transliteration is of the lexical reverse, not the legal obverse. A link to this record is therefore not proof that the model contract has been consulted.
concordances: P279582 and P278917 are retired identifiers
